text:
tara_csm: Heads-up — Aurion Health renewal. Procurement sent PO with vendor_code AURION-GLB-5 (doesn't match CRM). Asks: Net60, split invoices US/EU, add 35 seats, keep current unit price on a 12mo term, and attach PO to DocuSign. They also asked about a 4% prepay discount for 6 months. Any blockers?

niko_ae: On call now. Procurement says Net60 is their standard. I'll try to get single payor but they may insist on split. PO will be attached to the envelope. Asking about currency for EU portion.

ash_fin: Net60 with split invoices is possible but requires: 1) legal entity names, 2) US EIN and EU VAT, 3) confirmation of which entity accepts liability. If split remains, Finance may request credit approval or partial prepayment. Prepay discount ok pending currency.

yvonne_legal: Amendment recommended for seats + term. DocuSign OK; wet-sign adds 3-5 biz days. Need to confirm VAT treatment and whether any DPAs change for the EU entity. Also validate vendor_code mapping before invoicing.

mika_enable: If seats added, we can provide regional kickoff + 8 enablement hours. Holding a slot tentatively week after effective date — will release if not confirmed by EOD Thu.

tara_csm: Procurement excerpt: "VendorCode: AURION-GLB-5; PO# 660880; invoice 60% Aurion US (ap@aurion.us) / 40% Aurion EU (ap-eu@aurion.eu); prefer Net60; will sign via DocuSign; may prepay 6mo for 4% discount."

niko_ae: Requested US EIN and EU VAT on the call, plus AP contact names and whether AP will consolidate. Pushing for single payor.

ash_fin: Please confirm invoice currency for EU portion and provide VAT ID. Without those, Finance can't greenlight Net60 for split invoices. If they prepay, we can expedite.

yvonne_legal: Reviewing DocuSign draft once AE attaches PO. If they request indemnity or DPA tweaks for EU, escalate to Legal immediately.

docusign_bot: Draft amendment created (internal preview): https://docusign.example/envelope/aurion-660880 — fields: attach PO, billing allocation, signer roles.

tara_csm: Risk: "vendor_code mismatch" = high until registry updated; "Net60 + split invoices" = medium. Target: send DocuSign within 48h if IDs present; +3-5 biz days if wet-sign or credit steps required. I'll update renewal tracker.
